notes: Florida levies no personal income tax: Art. VII, s. 5(a) of the Florida Constitution bars a state tax on the income of natural persons who are residents (beyond amounts creditable against federal tax, of which there are none).
Only federal income tax and self-employment tax apply to a Florida freelancer's net profit.

seDeduction.note: Not applicable: Florida has no personal income tax.

seHealthInsurance.note: Not applicable: Florida has no personal income tax.

retirementContributions.note: Not applicable: Florida has no personal income tax.

qbi.note: Not applicable: Florida has no personal income tax.

localIncomeTax.note: No Florida city or county levies an income tax; the constitution only authorizes state-level taxes on income of entities other than natural persons. Local business tax receipts (flat occupational license fees) are not income-based and are not modeled.

estimatedTax.threshold: Not applicable: no state personal income tax.

businessCosts.llcFormationFee: $125 for a new Florida LLC ($100 filing fee + $25 registered agent designation fee).
businessCosts.annualReportFee: $138.75 per year (annual report incl. supplemental fee), due Jan 1-May 1; $538.75 if received after May 1 ($400 late fee).
businessCosts.franchiseOrMinimumTax: None. Florida corporate income tax (ch. 220) does not apply to a single-member LLC that is disregarded for federal tax purposes (s. 605.1103, F.S.) or to a sole proprietorship (s. 220.03(1)(e), F.S.).
businessCosts.grossReceiptsTax: None on general professional or freelance service income.
